title: Moments under the uniform measure
statement:
Let $P$ be a probability measure on the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$ that assigns every singleton the uniform weight $2^{-n}$. Then for any Boolean function $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ and any $p \in \bbn$, the $p$-th moment of $f$ under $P$ equals the uniform expectation of $f^p$:
\[
  \E_P\!\left[f^p\right] \;=\; 2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n} f(x)^p.
\]
hypotheses_covered: P is a probability measure on the Boolean hypercube
P assigns each singleton the uniform weight 2^{-n}
f is a Boolean function of arity n
replaced:
Let $P$ be a probability measure on $\{0,1\}^n$ that assigns the uniform weight
to each singleton.  Then for any Boolean function $f$ and $p\in\mathbb{N}$, the
$p$-th moment of $f$ under $P$ equals the uniform expectation of $f^p$:
\[
  \mathbb{E}_P[f^p] \;=\; \E\!\left[f(x)^p\right].
\]
